section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1999
title: 2.10 MEANS ADOPTED FOR COMMITTED SUICIDES 2.10.1 The means adopted for suicides varied from the easily available means such as consumption of poison, jumping into the well etc. to the more painful means such as self inflicted injuries, hanging, shooting etc. to commit suicide. Hanging (25.2%), Consumption of insecticides (18.3%) and Consumption of other poisons (18.9%) were the more used means to end one's life. Table-2.10
